cutscene.1.title: The Day the Sky Failed
cutscene.1.text: Afterfall turned whole cities into ruins and covered the land in strange dust.
cutscene.2.title: Nature Rewritten
cutscene.2.text: Plants twisted, animals mutated, and once-safe roads became hunting grounds.
cutscene.3.title: The Survivor Roads
cutscene.3.text: Scattered people searched for water, food, and anywhere the lights were still on.
cutscene.4.title: A Signal in the Dark
cutscene.4.text: A short radio transmission called survivors toward a valley in the north.
cutscene.5.title: The Walls of Greenvale
cutscene.5.text: Behind scrap-metal barricades, a small city is rebuilding life from the remains of the old world.
cutscene.6.title: A New Morning
cutscene.6.text: Today you leave the safe zone for the first time. Your story begins here.
